ODNR IS REQUESTING $780,500.00 IN FEDERAL FUNDS FOR FFY 2022 (YEAR 1) AND $833,940.00 IN FEDERAL FUNDS FOR FFY 2023 (YEAR 2) TOTALING $1,614,440.00. FEDERAL FUNDS WILL BE MATCHED WITH A TOTAL OF $691,903.00 IN NON-FEDERAL FUNDS FROM THE "LAKE ERIE SHORELINE" 5140 FUND. OWC NERR HAS RECEIVED A BUDGET ALLOCATION THAT CONTAINS FUNDS FOR BOTH PERSONNEL AND NON-PERSONNEL RELATED EXPENDITURES.
